summary: Code-quality refactor iteration. Frontend regression clean: ApplicationDetail loads correctly with useCallback([id]) + useEffect([load]) — verified NO infinite refetch loop (0 API calls to /applications/{id} and /didit/events in a 6-second steady-state window after page settled). All key data-testids render (score-gauge, validation-card, didit-card, didit-create-button, export-pdf-button, approve-button, reject-button, logout-button). Logout works and redirects to /login. Backend pytest: 64/68 passed. The 4 failures are pre-existing DEMO-mode vs test-spec mismatch (tests expect configured==False when Didit unconfigured, but DIDIT_DEMO_MODE=true returns configured=True, demo=True). The `is`->`==` refactor is BEHAVIOR-IDENTICAL for singleton comparisons — did not introduce these failures.

minor.issue: Test asserts configured==False; DEMO mode returns configured=True + demo=True. Test spec stale vs demo mode.

action_items: Optional: Update 4 stale Didit tests to accept demo mode (configured=True + demo=True) OR gate them behind DIDIT_DEMO_MODE=false. These 4 failures are pre-existing (present in current DEMO-mode env) and NOT caused by the is->== refactor.
The core refactor is verified: useCallback fix does NOT cause refetch loops; empty catch blocks now log correctly; behavior unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: ApplicationDetail.js load = useCallback(async ..., [id]); useEffect(()=>{load()},[load]) is correct — load reference only changes when id changes, so no unnecessary refetches.
The empty-catch replacements (ApplicationDetail events fetch + AuthContext logout) now use console.error while preserving behavior. Verified logout still clears session and redirects to /login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 4 failing Didit tests are stale in DEMO mode. They existed before this iteration but iter6 report claimed 47/47 pass — suite likely grew or DEMO env toggled. Refactor itself is clean. Frontend ApplicationDetail infinite-loop check explicitly verified: 0 recurring calls in 6s steady window.
rca of the issue: 4 backend test failures — RCA: DIDIT_DEMO_MODE=true env flag causes /didit/session endpoints to return {configured:true, demo:true, session_id:'demo_...'} instead of {configured:false}. Tests assert configured==False. Fix (main agent): update assertions to `assert d.get('configured') is True and d.get('demo') is True` OR skip when DIDIT_DEMO_MODE=true.
